approval_note: Website-published facts are the company's own public statements but have not yet been confirmed by the owner for sales use. Drafts that use them stay pending for human review. Change a fact's status to owner_approved once confirmed; set it to withdrawn to stop using it.

facts.text: Voxel1 Solutions Private Limited is a BIM services company based in India, serving the architecture, engineering and construction industry.
Project-level BIM modelling services include Scan to BIM and CAD to BIM.
Models can be produced from laser-scan data (Scan to BIM), PDF drawings (PDF to BIM), sketches (Sketch to BIM) and CAD drawings (CAD to BIM).
Models cover architecture, structure and MEPF, at the level of development the project requires (the website lists LOD 200 to LOD 500).
Services include site verification and as-built BIM updates, measured building data conversion, and BIM facility-management modelling.
Services include 3D BIM coordination and clash resolution, and 2D drawing production from the BIM model.
Services include 4D construction simulation and 5D BIM data management, including quantity (BOQ) extraction from the model.
Organisation-level services include BIM assessment, standards, workflows, a BIM road map, BIM team set-up, employer's information requirements and quality control.
Voxel1 sets up common data environments, including BIM 360 (Docs, Coordinate, Design and Build) with custom workflows, documentation and training.
Voxel1 develops custom BIM automation, including APIs and Dynamo scripts.
Delivery follows four stages: assessment, development, adoption and operation, with bi-weekly status reports and review meetings.
Voxel1 is happy to sign a mutual NDA before receiving project information, and defines scope and deliverables with the client before proposing.
Prospective clients can book a 30-minute call with the BIM team.
Portfolio lists Scan to BIM / PDF to BIM / Sketch to BIM work at LOD 300 on an 8,000-seat stadium and a 3,000-seat concert hall in the USA (clients not named).
